庭间 · 八首原创空间配乐 / Original arrangements (v20)
Composition, arrangement and digital performance: Tingjian Studio project, 2026.
No third-party melody or commercial recording is reproduced.

Instrument samples: FluidR3 General MIDI soundfont, Frank Wen and contributors;
MIDI.js MP3 conversion distributed by gleitz/midi-js-soundfonts.
Source: https://github.com/gleitz/midi-js-soundfonts/tree/master/FluidR3_GM
License: Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 United States
https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/us/
Changes: samples sequenced, sustained with crossfades, mixed with original synthesized
percussion, stereo room reflections, fades and loudness normalization.
Samples are used as instruments in these original rendered compositions.
